title: SATURDAY NIGHT BINGO
seo_title: Saturday Night Bingo at American Legion Post 138, Bolivar
description: Saturday night bingo at American Legion Howard S. Keeling Post 138 in Bolivar, Missouri, with BINGO games, Pull-Tabs, and Early Birds, plus lasagna on special in the kitchen and a bar open for adult beverages. Veterans and active service members get a free 6-pack or can upgrade to a 9-pack for $5, and the post is collecting non-perishable food items in November and December. It is for ages 16 and older, free to attend, and takes place November 14, 2026 (Time TBD) at 1424 W Broadway St.
venue: American Legion Howard S. Keeling Post 138
